Force of Will in P0 hand; separate genuinely BLUE NONLAND card in P0 hand; P1 casting valid target spell; no external legality reconstruction. Execution script must distinguish NORMAL_COST_AVAILABLE and ALTERNATE_COST_AVAILABLE then choose alternate. Pitch-card selection is hidden-zone decision until exiled. Retire every assertion stating Island itself is blue.

semantic_objective: Prove alternate-vs-mana payment fork with both routes genuinely legal: Force of Will must offer NORMAL_COST_AVAILABLE (3UU via five Islands) and ALTERNATE_COST_AVAILABLE (1 life + exile blue nonland Turn to Frog), pay the scripted pitch route via hidden-zone selection, and counter the target spell.

support_pitch_card_selection.alternatives_rejected: Willbender/Clone/Twincast/Cryptic Command are blue but only SCRYFALL_CROSSCHECK_CONSISTENT in RQ-C2 (not official-verified); adding a new card would require fresh Gatherer provenance with no benefit.
support_pitch_card_selection.rationale: Simplest suitable blue nonland support card whose color and Oracle identity are already officially verified in RQ-C2 (ORACLE_TEXT_VERIFIED, Gatherer CLU #103, {1}{U} Instant => blue per 105.2). No additional semantics relevant as pitch fuel (exiled as cost; text not invoked). Five untapped Islands fund 3UU as mana sources, NOT pitch. No new Oracle provenance required.
